title: Algebraic Classification of All 880 Fourth-Order Magic Squares and the Discovery of Complete Alternating Magic Squares
summary: In this paper, we introduce a newly defined algebraic invariant for square matrices termed the \emph{Alternating Power Difference (APD)}. The APD is defined as the signed sum of the powers of diagonal sums along permutations of the symmetric group, distinguishing between even and odd permutations. It serves as a measure of the broken even-odd symmetry inherent in a matrix through higher-order moments.
